name: application-social-post-card
title: Social Post Card
description: Social media post card with an avatar header, media body, and a real toggleable like action plus comment/share affordances — distinct from announcement-feed-item, which is pinned/starred admin content, not a user post.
useWhen: Rendering a single user-generated post with a photo/video body in a social feed.
You want the like button and count to be genuinely toggleable, not a static icon.
The card needs author identity, a caption, and engagement counts together.
avoidWhen: The content is admin-authored/pinned rather than a user post — use announcement-feed-item instead.
You need a text-only update with no media — a simpler card or activity-feed item is more appropriate.
Comments need to be shown inline, not just counted — pair this card with comment-thread below it.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a fixed max-width column (24rem) with a square media area; it reflows naturally in a single-column feed at any width.
accessibility: The like button carries aria-pressed reflecting its real toggled state and an aria-label stating both the action and the current like count.
Liked state is conveyed by both a filled heart icon and a color change, not the fill alone.
Author name in the header and in the caption line are both real text, not baked into an image.
